lab_questions.title: Django Bulk Operations and 3rd-Party Mocking
lab_questions.description:
Optimize Django database insertion performance using bulk operations and implement proper test isolation for external 3rd-party API calls using mocking/monkeypatching.

To authorize:
username = admin
password = adminpassword123
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py setup_superuser && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Optimize Bulk Insertion to a Single Query (bulk_create)
tasks.description:
The application provides an endpoint/management command to insert multiple books at once. Currently, the implementation loops through each item and performs individual row-by-row `Book.objects.create()` inserts, resulting in N database queries.

Under database efficiency standards, batch insertions must be performed in a single database transaction query using Django's `bulk_create`.

**Goal:** Refactor the insertion logic in `library/views.py` (and `library/management/commands/bulk_insert_books.py`) to use `Book.objects.bulk_create()` so that all records are inserted in at most **1 database query**.

tasks.title: Mock External 3rd-Party API Calls in Unit Tests
tasks.description:
The application integrates with an external 3rd-party Book Catalog API to fetch book details by ISBN (`library/services.py`). In unit tests, making live HTTP requests to external endpoints is brittle, slow, and fails due to network isolation or dummy URLs.

Currently, running `python manage.py test` fails with connection errors because `library/tests.py` makes real unmocked requests.

**Goal:** Fix `library/tests.py` by using `unittest.mock.patch` (or monkey patching) to mock the external HTTP call and return the expected static mock payload without making live network requests.
